summary: Verified the safe-area bottom-padding fix on all 5 tabs at 390x844 viewport. On every tab (Summary, Device, Flights, Sports, Weather) the last content (footer text) sits at y≈589-590 while the bottom tab bar begins at y≈780, giving ~190px of clearance so nothing is hidden behind the tab bar or the floating Sync FAB. Flights (the originally reported case) now shows the 'Track a Specific Flight' section and its 'Follow one flight' toggle fully visible after scrolling to end. ZIP input still accepts '10001' — no regression. Note: 'Landing alert' / 'Landing chime' toggles are conditionally rendered only when the 'Follow one flight' toggle is on (see flights.tsx:228 f.trackFlight guard); they are not missing — they appear when the toggle is enabled.
critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing benign: sports.tsx:388, weather.tsx:495, device.tsx:485, index.tsx:917 still have the old static 'paddingBottom: 150' in StyleSheet.create(). It's harmlessly overridden by the inline [styles.content, { paddingBottom: insets.bottom + 190 }] but could be cleaned up for consistency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bottom-padding fix (insets.bottom + 190) is applied and verified on all 5 tabs. Pre-existing web console noise: ESPN + adsb.lol CORS errors (native-only), a few RN-Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, React 19 element.ref) — none introduced by this change.
rca_of_issue: Bug was 'Flights bottom cut off behind tab bar + Sync FAB'. Root cause was scroll containers using a static paddingBottom of 150 which was insufficient on taller devices where insets.bottom + tab bar (~80) + FAB (~80) exceed that. Fix: each tab's contentContainerStyle now overrides with { paddingBottom: insets.bottom + 190 }. Verified: on 390x844 viewport, footer bottom = ~590 vs tab-bar top = 780 (190px clearance). Fix confirmed working.
